task: Establish Phase 24 SDK compatibility baseline and build reusable multi-mode smoke runner across all 10 SDK and toolchain areas.
observation: Running package-resolved test suites through Margo across Fast Debug (--interp), Native Debug, and Native Release exposed a clear, predictable capability boundary: pure algorithmic and format packages (moss.math, moss.encoding, moss.binary, moss.compress) achieve 100% semantic parity across all three engines in milliseconds, whereas host services (moss.fs) and source-free binary provider artifacts intentionally stop under Fast Debug due to preflight barriers (FAST_DEBUG_FILEIO and source-closure requirements). Incorporating explicit limitation detection directly into the smoke runner prevents diagnostic noise without masking genuine regressions.
impact: Enabled a fast (~30s) reproducible smoke suite across all 10 domains that accurately distinguishes true functional regressions from intended engine capability boundaries prior to combined compiler integration.

resolution.summary: Constructed reusable SDK smoke runner in tests/phase25/integration/sdk_compatibility_smoke.py with domain-level limitation reporting and documented the full compatibility matrix in docs/phase25/PHASE_24_SDK_COMPATIBILITY_BASELINE.md.
